questions.question_text: A stadium has 178,500 spectators. Ticket sales total 89,250,000 baht. What is the average ticket price?
questions.question_text_en: A stadium has 178,500 spectators. Ticket sales total 89,250,000 baht. What is the average ticket price?
questions.hint_th: Divide total revenue by number of spectators
questions.question_text_th: สนามกีฬามีผู้ชม 178,500 คน. ขายบัตรได้ 89,250,000 บาท. ราคาเฉลี่ยบัตรเท่าไร?

questions.question_text: Mali has 250,000 baht. She buys a motorcycle for 185,500 baht. How much money does Mali have left?
questions.question_text_en: Mali has 250,000 baht. She buys a motorcycle for 185,500 baht. How much money does Mali have left?
questions.question_text_th: มะลิมี 250,000 บาท. ซื้อรถจักรยานยนต์ 185,500 บาท. เหลือเงิน?

questions.question_text: A company has income of 1,250,000 baht and expenses of 875,500 baht. How much money does the company have left?
questions.question_text_en: A company has income of 1,250,000 baht and expenses of 875,500 baht. How much money does the company have left?
questions.question_text_th: บริษัทมีรายได้ 1,250,000 บาท ค่าใช้จ่าย 875,500 บาท. เหลือเงินเท่าไร?

questions.question_text: A department store sold 567,800 baht on day 1 and 489,500 baht on day 2. How much more was sold on day 1?
questions.question_text_en: A department store sold 567,800 baht on day 1 and 489,500 baht on day 2. How much more was sold on day 1?
questions.question_text_th: ห้างขายได้ 567,800 บาทวันแรก 489,500 บาทวันที่สอง. วันแรกขายได้มากกว่ากี่บาท?

questions.question_text: A shop has goods worth 350,000 baht. It sells half. How much money does it get and what is the value of remaining goods?
questions.question_text_en: A shop has goods worth 350,000 baht. It sells half. How much money does it get and what is the value of remaining goods?
questions.question_text_th: ร้านมีสินค้า 350,000 บาท. ขายไปครึ่งหนึ่ง. ได้เงินเท่าไร เหลือมูลค่าเท่าไร?

questions.hint_th: Move the addend to the other side as subtrahend

questions.question_text: A fruit shop earned 456,780 baht but the cost was 289,450 baht. What is the profit?
questions.question_text_en: A fruit shop earned 456,780 baht but the cost was 289,450 baht. What is the profit?
questions.question_text_th: ร้านขายผลไม้ได้เงิน 456,780 บาท ต้นทุน 289,450 บาท. กำไรเท่าไร?

questions.question_text: A shop buys goods for 125,750 baht and sells them for 189,500 baht. What is the profit?
questions.question_text_en: A shop buys goods for 125,750 baht and sells them for 189,500 baht. What is the profit?
questions.hint_th: Profit = selling price minus purchase price
questions.question_text_th: ร้านซื้อสินค้า 125,750 บาท ขายได้ 189,500 บาท. กำไรเท่าไร?

questions.question_text: Lin buys a book for 67,800 baht and a pencil for 2,450 baht. Total? If she pays with 80,000 baht, how much change?
questions.question_text_en: Lin buys a book for 67,800 baht and a pencil for 2,450 baht. Total? If she pays with 80,000 baht, how much change?
questions.question_text_th: ลินซื้อหนังสือ 67,800 บาท ดินสอ 2,450 บาท. รวม? จ่าย 80,000 บาท ทอนเท่าไร?
